//: Static analysis for the browser app. TypeScript is used only as a checker:
noEmit means it produces no JavaScript, and the deployed sources stay the
.js files under asl-web/js that the browser loads directly.
The app has no module system. moduleDetection 'legacy' keeps each file a
classic script sharing one global scope, which is how index.html loads them
and how the JSDoc typedefs resolve across files.
